Magical.name: Summon Life Cubic
Magical.description: Summons a Life Cubic. The Life Cubic uses magic to regenerate HP to its owner and party members.

Magical.name: Summon Smart Cubic
Magical.description:
Summons Smart Cubic.
This Cubic:
Inflicts magic damage on enemy.
Stuns enemy.
Removes all debuffs from the master.

Magical.name: Heal
Magical.description: Restores the target's HP with 50 Power.

Magical.name: Cure Poison
Magical.description: Cures the target of minor poisoning.

Magical.name: Battle Heal
Magical.description: Immediately restores the target's HP with 83 Power.

Magical.name: Group Heal
Magical.description: Restores all party members' HP with 66 Power.

Magical.name: Servitor Recharge
Magical.description: Recovers the servitor's MP with up to 41 Power depending on the servitor's level.

Magical.name: Servitor Heal
Magical.description: Recovers the servitor's HP with 169 Power.

Magical.name: Aqua Swirl
Magical.description: Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 23 Power to create a powerful vortex of Water that inflicts Water damage on an enemy.

Magical.name: Wind Strike
Magical.description: Supplements the user's M. Atk. with 12 Power to create a powerful hurricane that inflicts Wind damage on an enemy.

Magical.name: Summon Boxer the Unicorn
Magical.description: Summons Boxer the Unicorn.

Magical.name: Summon Mirage the Unicorn
Magical.description: Summons Mirage the Unicorn for assistance in combat.

Magical.name: Summon Merrow the Unicorn
Magical.description: Summons the servitor Merrow the Unicorn.

Magical.name: Summon Aqua Cubic
Magical.description: Summons Aqua Cubic. Aqua Cubic uses attack magic that inflicts continuous damage to an enemy.

Magical.name: Servitor Cure
Magical.description: Cures servitor of minor bleeding or poisoning.

Magical.name: Servitor Blessing
Magical.description: Frees servitor of Hold, paralysis and decreased Atk. Spd. or movement effects.

Magical.name: Mass Summon Aqua Cubic
Magical.description: Summons Aqua Cubic for party members. Aqua Cubic uses attack magic that inflicts continuous damage to an enemy.

Magical.name: Summon Friend
Magical.description: Teleports a party member to one's current location. Requires a Summon Crystal on the target.

Magical.name: Summon Magnus the Unicorn
Magical.description: Summon the servitor Magnus the Unicorn.

Magical.name: Dimension Spiral
Magical.description:
Creates a tear in the dimension to inflict damage on an enemy with 57 Power added to M. Atk.
Over-hit is possible.

Magical.name: Replace
Magical.description: Switches locations with the target servitor. Range: 700 Cooldown: 60 seconds.

Buff.name: Servitor Magic Shield

Buff.name: Servitor Haste

Buff.description: Increases the servitor's P. Def. by 1800, M. Def. by 1350, and resistance to buff-canceling attacks by 80%. It is unable to move while the skill is in effect.

Buff.name: Improved Combat
Buff.description:
Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects.
P. Atk. +6%
P. Def. +6%.

Buff.description: Increases the user's P. Atk. by 3%, M. Atk. by 3%, skill P. Atk. by 5%, Atk. Spd. by 2%, Cast. Spd. by 1%, and critical rate by 5%. The effect applies to both the master and their summon.

Buff.name: Servitor Share
Buff.description:
Extends the summoner's abilities to the servitor:
50% of P. Atk./P. Def.
25% of M. Atk./M. Def.
15% of Max HP/MP
25% of P. Crit. Rate
15% of Atk. Spd.
5% of Cast. Spd.

Buff.name: Mass Improved Combat
Buff.description:
Combines 'Might' and 'Shield' effects.
For party members:
P. Atk. +6%
P. Def. +6%.

Debuff.name: Mass Surrender to Water
Debuff.description:
Resistance to Water -19%.
When applied, cancels 'Resist Aqua' and prevents it from being rebuffed.

Toggle.description:

M. Skills Reuse Time -10%

Consumes 35 HP per second.

Restores HP. Power: 420.
